newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan welcomes Annan as new head of United Nations.
newsitem.headline: Japan welcomes Annan as new head of United Nations.

text.p: Japan on Saturday welcomed the appointment of Ghana's Kofi Annan as the next secretary-general of the United Nations, Kyodo News Service reported.
"Priority should be given to a candidate from Africa, from which the present secretary-general comes," the news agency quoted a top Foreign Ministry official as saying.

The official said Japan expects Annan, who will replace Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali, to succeed in reforming the 185-member world body because he is familiar with U.N. budgets, Kyodo reported.

Foreign ministry officials said they will be eyeing Annan's performance carefully regarding Japan's bid to become a permanent member of the U.N. Security Council and regarding reform of the council, the news agency said.
